title: Using Context Clues to Figure Out New Words
skills: infer the meaning of unfamiliar words
use surrounding text to determine word meaning
identify clues provided by sentences and passages
apply context-clue strategies during independent reading
alignment_note: Teaches how readers can use surrounding language and textual clues to determine the meaning of unfamiliar words. Reinforces vocabulary acquisition, close reading, and independent comprehension strategies that transfer across high school English courses.
